title: The data of cycle.started
description: A cycle's start is on record. Witness: the cycle in running of tehas status --json, or its first work line in tehas history --json. Version 1 of the events. host/docs/api.md, "Events", says what each field means. The object is closed; a minor release may add an optional field. console/tests/events_contract.rs checks the samples beside this file against it.

cycle.description: The cycle id, <blueprint>-<attempt>, unique within one store.

blueprint.description: The blueprint, the factory API's issue.

ticket.description: The ticket, in the ports' shape. Left out when it is the blueprint.

how.description: What started the cycle, as status and history print it: approved, refresh, outage-retry, millwright, host, reply, answer or hand. May grow.

by.description: The login that started it. Left out for a cycle run by hand.
